config.preconditioned_baseline: native jax.scipy CG with exact diagonal/Jacobi inverse; for the constant-coefficient Poisson stencil this is a scalar and should not change Krylov work
config.timing_outlier_rule: repetition > 1.5 * its case median; diagnose only, never discard
config.balanced_pair_contract: within each case: burn, learned then zero; reburn, zero then learned; repeat with exact equal positions; grade every timed invocation
config.balanced_control_contract: zero CG, dense DST, FFT-DST, and every spectral arm use forward cyclic rotations plus their reverses; each method has equal occupancy at every position and every pair has equal precedence, with a fresh burn before each order and whole-case bootstrap inference

rbf_train_only.selection: fixed train-only calibration split; no PDE held-out cases
